title: Checkout
noLocations: Your company has no active delivery location yet.
pendingDescription: We couldn't confirm whether your order was placed. Checking repeats the exact same submission safely — it never creates a second order.
viaDraft: This order is placed from a shared draft; placing it uses the draft up.
uncertainDescription: The connection dropped before we got an answer. Use “Check status” — it repeats the same submission safely.
problemTitle: The order can't be placed yet

issue.QUANTITY_INVALID: The quantity of {product} no longer fits its minimum or step.
issue.DELIVERY_UNAVAILABLE: The delivery location is no longer available.
issue.RELATIONSHIP_UNAVAILABLE: You're no longer connected with this vendor.
issue.REPLACEMENT_UNAVAILABLE: The order this one replaces can no longer be replaced.

staffRestricted: Your company lets only owners and admins place orders. You can prepare the order and save it as a draft for them.
incomplete: Choose a delivery location and add at least one product.
detailsDescription: They are part of the order and visible to the vendor.
contactOverride: Use a different contact person for this order
contactFromOrganization: This location has no saved contact — enter one for this order.
replacementFor: This order replaces a cancelled order.
receiptValidUntil: These prices are held for review until {time} (nothing is reserved).
receiptExpired: This review expired. Review the order again to see current prices.
reviewFirst: {count, plural, one {# product in the cart.} other {{countText} products in the cart.}} Review the order to see exact prices.
savedForTeam: Saved — an owner or admin can place it from Saved drafts.
noPayment: No payment now — it's arranged directly with the vendor.
largeDescription: These lines have unusually large quantities. Place the order anyway?
